headnotes.text: A prima facie case of racially discriminatory discipline under Title VII requires showing membership in a protected class, misconduct comparable in seriousness to that of employees outside the class, and more severe discipline. Comparators need not have committed precisely the same offenses; the burden then shifts under McDonnell Douglas, while plaintiff keeps the ultimate burden.
